amendments.title: Support: Send message hidden behind the iPhone keyboard
amendments.what: Smoke test 2026-09-19 (iPhone 16, Expo Go): with the cursor in 'Your message' the keyboard covers Send. The 2026-09-16 fix made Send reachable by scrolling but never brought it into view.
amendments.fix: ScrollView ref + scrollToEnd when the keyboard shows while the message box has focus (and on focus if the keyboard is already up). Android unproven: emulator soft keyboard was off.

amendments.title: Android: bottom nav rides on top of the keyboard
amendments.what: Pixel 7 (API 34), Support message box: Android resizes the window, so the bottom nav sits above the keys and eats typing room. On the iPhone the keyboard covers it.
amendments.fix: BottomNav returns null on Android while the keyboard is up (keyboardDidShow/Hide). iOS untouched. Header comment names the divergence.

amendments.title: Privacy Notice: no way back when it fails to load (or while loading)
amendments.what: Offline, open the Privacy Notice from sign-in/OTP: 'couldn't be loaded' shows with no ← Back, so a signed-out teacher is stranded. Cause: PrivacyNotice.jsx returns early for the failed AND loading states, before the head that carries onBack. Row expects 'Back still works'. Check the phone's privacy route for the same shape during the phone walk.

amendments.title: Expired OTP: boxes stay live; 'Send a new code' only a link; mid-run Resend to go
amendments.what: Once the 60s code expires, Verify disappears but the six boxes still accept typing and paste — she can fill a code she can never submit. And 'Send a new code', now the only thing on offer, is a small lgl-link inside the quiet line. Founder: when expired, the boxes should not accept input, and 'Send a new code' should be a full-size button in Verify's place (same size as 'Verify & continue →'). Login.jsx's own comment already says 'sending a new code is the only thing on offer'. Check the phone's OTP screen for the same shape. ALSO (founder decision 2026-09-20): REMOVE the mid-run 'Resend' that appears at 0:30 left (otpCanResend / OTP_RESEND_LOCK_MS) — it can invalidate a code she is halfway through typing and saves at most 30s; the full-size 'Send a new code' at expiry is the only resend. Matches the row and Login.jsx's own 'NO Resend while it runs' comment. Check the phone for the same Resend.

amendments.title: First-run wheels: roll continuously; keyboard arrows after on-screen ▲▼
amendments.what: (1) Founder: the first-run wheels should roll CONTINUOUSLY — past the last item back to the first — as My Lessons' Subject/Class wheels already do. RollWheel's loop mode is gated on `peek` ('the base wheel (FirstRun) is untouched'); extend it to first run (subject + class certainly; chapter wheel: founder to confirm, since wrapping hides where the chapter list ends). Phone wheels are ports — same change. (2) Web: ↑↓ keys step the wheel only when the wheel itself has focus; after clicking the on-screen ▲/▼ focus sits on the button and the keyboard arrows do nothing. Keep focus on the wheel after an arrow-button click (or let the buttons forward ↑↓). Also seen on the CLASS wheel (03.24).

amendments.title: Chapter wheel: drop the 'Chapter N:' prefix; larger chapter label (web only)
amendments.what: (1) Each chapter row shows the number in the green chip AND a title reading 'Chapter 4: …' — the number twice. The label is c.chapter_title verbatim (FirstRun.jsx ~742), so the prefix comes from the chapter data; strip a leading 'Chapter N:' for display in this wheel (check whether other surfaces show the same doubling before deciding to strip at the API). (2) The chapter label reads small against 'Choose the chapter to teach' — raise it on WEB. ★ Founder: the size change is WEB ONLY; the phone's chapter-label size is to be reviewed on its own during the phone walk, NOT carried over automatically. The prefix removal (1) is a content fix — decide for the phone during its walk too.

amendments.title: Chapter step: 'Change' wheels for duration/periods far smaller than the settled value
amendments.what: Opening 'Change' on Class duration or Estimated periods shows a RollWheel whose number/label is much smaller than the value displayed in the box after 'Done' — the edit state shrinks the very figure she is choosing. Review the size so the editing wheel reads at least as large as the settled value (the subject/class wheels pass `large`; the duration/periods wheels at FirstRun.jsx ~762/~795 do not). Sits with WALK-A-006 (chapter label size) — review the step's type scale as one. ★ WEB ONLY; the phone's sizes are reviewed on their own in the phone walk, not carried over.

amendments.title: Web: browser Back leaves Meyy from any screen
amendments.what: Pressing the browser Back button on My Lessons (just after first run) took her OUT of Meyy to the page before it (the incognito start page), not to Meyy's previous screen. Cause: the web shell never writes browser history (no pushState/popstate anywhere in web/app — screens and tabs are React state on one URL), so Back always exits the app, from every screen. The row's own rule is kept (Back must never return INTO first run). Founder to decide the shape: e.g. push a history entry for tab switches, an opened lesson, Settings and its subviews, so Back steps within Meyy; replace (not push) across the first-run → shell boundary so Back can never re-enter first run; and at the root, either leave the app or stay. A whole-web change — walk every family's Back afterwards.

amendments.title: Tour offer is lost if she leaves before answering it
amendments.what: After first run, browser Back left Meyy (WALK-A-008); Forward reloaded the app onto My Classes with NO tour offer, and 'Would you like to check your set-up?' popped instead. Cause: the offer is spent the moment it is SHOWN (POST /account/tour-offered sets tour_offered_at), and after a reload `tourSpent` reads that and `tourOfferedThisSession` has reset — so any reload, Back-and-Forward, closed tab or dropped connection between the offer appearing and her answering it removes the tour for good, and the first-run set-up check (meant to follow the tour) fires in its place. Founder decision: spend the offer on an ANSWER (Take the tour / Skip / ✕) rather than on display, or allow one re-offer after a reload. Check the phone for the same (app killed while the offer is up). Walk workaround used: clear tour_offered_at on 9000000002. FURTHER (same walk): after clearing tour_offered_at and reloading, the server was re-stamped at 05:50:30 — the offer was 'made' on reload — yet it was visible on NEITHER surface: the reload lands on My Classes, where the offer renders only while no section is bound (MyPlans !anyBound — never true after first run binds 9A), and it did not appear on My Lessons either. So the offer is spent while not on screen at all. Tour parked on 02 for this web cycle; walked on a second clean cycle.
amendments.files: web/app/page.jsx (tourOnOffer / tour-offered effect), api/main.py mark_tour_offered, mobile shell

amendments.title: Year Plan table unreadable (dark) in a fresh incognito window
amendments.what: Desktop Chrome incognito (fresh storage, so theme pref = default 'system'): the Year Plan table appears dark and its figures are only visible when selected — text and background too close. Rest of the screen not reported dark. Suspect a theme mismatch: dark tokens (or the OS dark scheme / color-scheme) reaching the table cells while the page stays light, or a hardcoded colour. Check with macOS in dark vs light appearance and aruvi-theme unset; compare with the tracker's normal window. Founder's Mac appearance: DARK. So with theme 'system' the desktop web half-follows the OS: the table goes dark while the page stays light (CLAUDE.md: the dark theme flip lives in the ≤600px block — desktop was meant to stay light, but something in .yp-* or color-scheme is reaching the table). CONFIRMED: switching the Mac to Light makes the table readable — the defect follows the OS appearance only.

amendments.title: Create sign in: mobile field keeps the old number after Back
amendments.what: OTP screen (create path) → ← Back to Choose → 'Create sign in →' again: the OTP boxes and sent state reset correctly, but the mobile field still holds the number typed before. Row 03.03 expects an empty field. Founder decision 2026-09-20: CLEAR the mobile field whenever the create OTP screen is entered afresh. Check the phone for the same.

amendments.title: Rejoining teacher's trial card says 3 chapters when fewer remain
amendments.what: After erase + rejoin, the server seeds the trial with the ledger's used chapters (_entitlement_of → '_earlier/1', so 2 left), but FirstRun's 'Your free trial' card prints trialInfo.trial_chapter_cap — 'covers any 3 chapters' — the CAP, not what she has left. A rejoiner is promised a chapter she does not have. Show the remaining count when it is below the cap (e.g. 'You have 2 of your 3 free chapters left'), cap wording otherwise. Check the phone's card. (Considered and WITHDRAWN by founder: 'Prepare my second lesson' — her earlier lesson was erased, so for her this IS the first lesson; the CTA stays.)

amendments.title: Tour offer box doesn't read as something to click
amendments.what: The 'Let me show you around first' box (the whole box is the button) shows a '→' mark at its top-left but gives no explicit invitation — nothing tells the teacher to click the box to begin the tour. Make the call to action explicit and visibly a control (e.g. a real 'Show me how →' button/link styled as one, or 'Tap to start the tour'). Check the phone's nudge too.

amendments.title: Tour offer missing on My Classes; chapter pre-attached before the tour
amendments.what: (1) After first run the offer shows only on My Lessons. MyPlans renders it only while !anyBound, and first run now binds 9A, so My Classes never shows it — T.02 and 03.28 expect it on BOTH. Founder: it should be on both. (2) Founder: chapter 4 already shows ATTACHED to 9A on My Classes before the tour is taken or skipped; the tour's steps 8–10 teach attaching. Founder view: the binding should not precede the tour's resolution. ⚠️ Conflicts with the 2026-08-21/09-14 design (first run hands her a real bound card; tour steps 7–14 anchor on it; T.27 covers 'only lesson attached') — decide the intended order before fixing; if first run stops binding, re-check 03.28, the tour's demo binding and T.25 (Skip gives back her binding).
amendments.files: web/app/components/MyPlans.jsx, page.jsx (first-run binding / tour demo binding) + phone

amendments.title: Tour tells her to click (card, '+') but clicks do nothing — only Next advances
amendments.what: Step 6 tip reads 'Let us open the lesson' / 'click on the lesson card to open a particular lesson', while the tour advances only on Next — a teacher following the words clicks the card instead. Founder: reword so she is not led to click the card directly (e.g. 'Tapping a lesson card opens it. Press Next and we'll open this one for you.'). Same copy on the phone (GuidedTour steps are shared). Observed: clicking the card during step 6 does nothing at all (the tour blocks it), so she is told to do something that silently fails. SAME at step 8 (T.11): 'Click the + sign of that section card' — clicking '+' does nothing. Review EVERY step whose copy says click/tap: either make the click itself advance the tour (the natural choice where the tour then does exactly that action — steps 6 and 8), or reword to point at Next. Step 9 (T.12) likewise: 'Select a lesson plan…' — clicking the row does nothing; include it in the same review.

amendments.title: Tour step 7 says 'section your section' — target section never reaches the tour
amendments.what: Step 7 tip: 'We will now attach this lesson to section your section from ‘My Classes’…'. Body is `…to section ${i.tag}…` and i.tag falls back to 'your section' (GuidedTour.jsx fallback) because tourInfo is null. tourInfo {tag, chapter} is supplied ONLY by MyPlans (My Classes) via onTourInfo — and since 2026-09-17 the tour opens and stays on My Lessons for steps 1–7, so MyPlans never reports the target before step 7 (and on web it may be unmounted). Fix: derive the tour's target section in page.jsx (it already knows the demo binding), not from MyPlans' render; and make the fallback read grammatically ('…attach this lesson to one of your sections…'). Check any later step that uses i.tag / i.chapter. Phone has the same copy and the same info plumbing — check.
amendments.files: web/app/page.jsx (tourInfo), web/app/components/GuidedTour.jsx (fallback), MyPlans.jsx onTourInfo; mobile equivalents

amendments.title: Tour copy corrections
amendments.what: Running list of tour wording fixes (shared web/phone copy). (1) Step 10: 'You have successfully attached “{chapter}” for section {tag}.' → 'attached “{chapter}” TO section {tag}.' Note its next sentence 'Let us click it to see how tracking works.' is another click-instruction — see WALK-A-015. (2) Step 15: 'the same window shown in step 8' → 'step 9' (the picker is step 9 of 20). Better: avoid step numbers in copy ('the same window you used a moment ago') so a re-ordering can't make it wrong again. (3) Step 16 (Add): 'Add/amend sections, classes and/or subjects. Use this button to quickly add sections, classes or subjects…' — WRONG: the Add window has no Subject row (a subject is a purchase), and it DOES amend periods a week and the annual period budget. Reword to match its four rows: class · section · periods a week · annual period budget. (4) Step 17 (profile): remove the final clause '; removing a subject is the one thing done here.' — end at 'Changes are made with ‘Add’ at the foot of the screen.' (5) Step 18 (Ask Meyy): 'up to 100 questions across 5 categories' — the bank holds 119 Q&A pairs in 5 categories. Say 'over 100' or drop the number (it will drift every monthly refresh).

amendments.title: Ghost account: a request after erasure re-creates the account
amendments.what: Cycle 3: 02 erased from the web (farewell, Done → Choose all normal). 'Create sign in' with 9000000002 then refused: 'already in use'. The account record exists again, created 2026-09-20T08:04:56Z (moments after the erase), display_name = the number, consent {} — never signed up. Cause: _current_identity JIT-creates an Account for ANY authenticated request (api/main.py ~303–310); a request still carrying the erased teacher's session (a poll, a re-fetch, the farewell's own refresh, sign-out cleanup) lands after the erase and resurrects her. Timing-dependent — cycle 2's rejoin was clean. Consequences: 'Create sign in' refuses her; an empty account now holds her number; data-rights promise ('all your data deleted') is undercut by a recreated record. The trial was NOT reopened (entitlement seeded from the ledger: _earlier/1, _earlier/2). Fix directions: sign out/clear the session BEFORE the erase request returns control (client) and/or refuse JIT creation for a token whose account was erased after the token was issued (server: compare token iat with the erasure time, or keep a short-lived tombstone). Check the phone's delete flow.
amendments.files: api/main.py (_current_identity JIT, data_rights_erase), web delete flow (Settings.jsx / page.jsx), mobile delete flow

amendments.title: Failed first lesson: message clipped, card looks attached, set-up check fires anyway
amendments.what: First run with the network off at Prepare (web, narrow width, dark theme). (1) The failed card clips its own sentence: 'Couldn't build the lesson plan right now. Try again in a…' — the one line that tells her what happened is cut; it must wrap in full. (2) The card keeps a clay left edge; the founder read it as 'attached'. A failed card should not borrow a lifecycle colour — give it a neutral or error treatment. (3) There is no retry on the card — only Dismiss; consider 'Try again' beside Dismiss (she chose the chapter, duration and periods already). (4) Visiting My Classes then raised 'Would you like to check your set-up?' — first run's one-shot fires because no tour is on offer (no lesson exists), so she is asked to audit a set-up before she has anything; hold the check until a first lesson exists (or until the tour resolves). Screenshot on file in the walk thread. (5) After dismissing the failure and preparing ch 4 successfully online, NO tour offer appeared (tour_offered_at still ''). Likely cause: tourEligible is computed ONCE, on [ready, user] (page.jsx ~124–139) from GET /section-state — the shell became ready while the network was off, the fetch failed → tourEligible null, and nothing recomputes it. So a teacher whose first lesson fails is never offered the tour in that session. Recompute eligibility when a plan lands (onPrepared) or on reconnect.
amendments.files: web/app/components/MyLessonPlans.jsx (preparing/failed card), globals.css, page.jsx (first-run check gate) + phone

amendments.title: First run offline: profile never saved, yet the shell opens
amendments.what: Cycle 3: first run completed with the network OFF at 'Prepare the lesson'. The shell opened (My Lessons with a failed card; My Classes with an empty 9A card) and she then prepared ch 4 successfully online from My Lessons. A reload (⌘R) put her back on 'Welcome to Meyy!' — first run again. So the profile write made at activation (POST /readiness, fired in the same tick as the handoff) failed offline, but the client moved her into the shell as if it had succeeded; the SS IX · 9A profile she saw existed only in the browser. Work done in that session (the prepared lesson) sits against an account with no profile. Fix: verify the activation write (the read-after-write verify used elsewhere) and, on failure, keep her in first run with a plain retry — never open the shell on an unsaved profile; or queue and retry the write. Check the phone.
